verification.detail: 19 files changed, 61 insertions(+), 347 deletions(-). Per-package gates counts: workers/error-ingest 31, packages/io 76, packages/core 859, packages/protocol 10, apps/server 410, apps/web 1582 = 2968.

items.notes:
SCOPE EXPANDED per Trent's 2026-07-29 decision: the kit-mirror feature is removed end-to-end (client AND server), not just the orphaned component. The finding's option (b) was taken.

BOUNDARY FOUND DURING TRACING — the brief's premise that 'the setKitGlobal client path' is dead is WRONG and that part was NOT removed. `setKitGlobal` is a shared kit-global message that also carries the live C1/C2 Advatek/kit config (expanded, ledDensityPxPerM, hoopCount, defaultHoopSpacingMm, maxPixelsPerOutput), edited by reachable UI: PatchKitInspector.svelte, PatchControllerInspector.svelte, and apps/web/src/lib/app/shot-seam.ts. So the message, the store's setKitGlobal method, Engine.setKitGlobal, VoiceEngineHost.setKitGlobal, the input-router/voice-input cases and client-message.ts:524's reloadOutputSettings gate all SURVIVE. Only the `mirror` FIELD was cut from each of them. Likewise packages/core/src/modifiers/impl/mirror.ts is an unrelated spatial modifier effect and is untouched.

WHAT WAS REMOVED: kitGlobalSchema.mirror (core); reflectWorld + every mirror application in buildPixelModel (core); 'mirror' from the Engine/VoiceEngineHost setKitGlobal Pick unions; mirrorSchema + the `mirror` field on the setKitGlobal protocol message; the msg.mirror forwarding in input-router.ts and handlers/voice-input.ts; store.setKitMirror; KitGlobalPartial.mirror; the mirror branch of projectResyncMessages; PatchMirrorControl.svelte.

EXPORTED SYMBOLS REMOVED (2): store.setKitMirror (TriggerLab public method) and the PatchMirrorControl component default export. reflectWorld was module-private. The finding predicted 1 removed symbol; the extra one is the expanded server/client scope Trent approved.

TEST COUNT: 2981 baseline - 13 removed = 2968, exactly as measured. The 13 removed tests are ALL mirror-only:
  packages/core/src/geometry/mirror.test.ts (whole file, 7 tests): mirror 'x' negates world X; mirror 'y' negates world Y; reflects tangent+normal+effect origin identically; is an involution; preserves pixel count and index order; leaves the DMX map byte-identical regardless of mirror; composes with flip.
  apps/server/src/kit-global-forwarding.test.ts (3): forwards mirror to engine.setKitGlobal; forwards mirror to voiceHost.setKitGlobal; forwards mirror:'none' explicitly.
  apps/web/src/lib/trigger-lab/store/project-resync.test.ts (2): emits only setKitGlobal when the mirror differs; does not carry expanded when only the mirror moved.
  apps/web/src/lib/trigger-lab/store.routing.test.ts (1): sets the kit-global mirror live.
Three further tests used `mirror` merely as a convenient kit-global field while asserting SURVIVING behaviour; they were RETARGETED onto `expanded`/`maxPixelsPerOutput` rather than deleted, so their coverage is unchanged: 'emits every changed slice at once (mixed edit)' (project-resync), 'undoes a kit-global edit — restores kit.global.expanded and re-sends setKitGlobal' and 'interleaves cleanly — undo peels the last edit first' (store.routing).

NO KIT SCHEMA VERSION BUMP: kitGlobalSchema is non-strict, so a persisted project carrying a legacy `mirror` key is silently stripped by parseKit. No migration is needed and none was added.

docs/design-system.html was regenerated with `pnpm design-system` (AGENTS.md non-negotiable); the only diff is the auto-globbed source-pointer map dropping PatchMirrorControl plus the bundled kitGlobalSchema losing its mirror field.
